item.title: Distinct SMARCAD1 domains enable R-loop binding and facilitate R-loop-associated conflict resolution at active replication forks
item.content:encoded:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79364-1

During DNA replication stalled transcription and R-loops need to be removed to allow replication fork progression. Here the authors show that the chromatin remodeler SMARCAD1, which associates with active replication forks, resolves R-loops near nascent DNA to maintain fork stability.
